# Charisma of the Coterie vs. Charisma of the Masses

Mazzini vs. Garibaldi, from Christopher Clark’s _Revolutionary Spring_

>But while Mazzini could be luminous at the dinner table and in the company of small groups, he was a poor orator and found it difficult to make an impression on a crowd. He possessed the 'charisma of the coterie', sufficient to mobilize a hard core of supporters, but he lacked the 'charisma of the masses' that would accumulate around Garibaldi.
content_html:
Charisma of the Coterie vs. Charisma of the Masses

Mazzini vs. Garibaldi, from Christopher Clark’s Revolutionary Spring

But while Mazzini could be luminous at the dinner table and in the company of small groups, he was a poor orator and found it difficult to make an impression on a crowd. He possessed the 'charisma of the coterie', sufficient to mobilize a hard core of supporters, but he lacked the 'charisma of the masses' that would accumulate around Garibaldi.
